title: Hurricane
logline: A storm gathers, seizes everything, carries you flying into its calm eye — then chaos, and the long fall back to earth.
energy_shape: steady menacing build, violent takeover, soaring lift, a still weightless eye, all-out chaos, then a long descending release
tempo_feel: rising urgency, relentless at the peak
must_have_moments: a weightless peaceful eye in the middle
dead silence right before the chaos returns
a long falling descent to end
avoid: ending on a climax — it must land, not cut
notes: the eye should feel genuinely safe so the returning chaos hurts; the fall is downward motion, not just quiet
